title: Bharat
desc: During the India-Pakistan partition, Bharat is separated from his family and left to care for those who remain. He spends his life trying to uphold the promise he made to his father.

title: Uunchai
desc: Three retired friends trek to Everest Base Camp to honour their dying friend's wish. Along the way, they discover freedom, friendship, and the deeper meaning of life.

title: Prem Ratan Dhan Payo
desc: A commoner named Prem swaps places with Prince Vijay Singh before a tense coronation. As plots unfold, Princess Maithili, meant to wed Vijay, finds herself drawn to Prem.

title: Aitraaz
desc: Raj, a married man, is falsely accused of rape by his ex-girlfriend, now his boss's wife. Pushed to the edge, he fights back by suing her for sexual harassment despite pressure.

title: Satyam Shivam Sundaram
desc: Rajeev marries Roopa, a beautiful singer, but he struggles to accept her when he discovers her disfigured face, causing emotional pain and conflict in their relationship.

title: Sniff
desc: Sunny Gill, born without smell, gains superpowers after a lab accident enhances his senses. He transforms into a superhero, discovering strength and purpose in his new identity.

title: Hello Darling
desc: Candy, Mansi, and Satvari work at a fashion store, but face constant harassment from their creepy manager Hardhik, making their daily lives stressful and full of uncomfortable challenges.

title: Main Prem Ki Deewani Hoon
desc: When Prem's mother finds him a match, he's unable to meet the family and asks his employee and best friend, also called Prem, to meet them.

title: Raid 2
desc: Income Tax officer Amay Patnaik takes on a corrupt nexus in Bhoj, exposing Dada Bhai's sinister empire. As deceit unravels, one question remains-can truth defeat power?

title: Maine Pyar Kiya
desc: Prem and Suman's love story faces a tough test when family feuds drive them apart. Can Prem overcome the obstacles and prove he's deserving of Suman's heart?

title: Gangster
desc: Simran moves to Seoul for a new life, but chaos returns when gangster Daya re-enters her world. Torn between him and Akash, a singer, she faces a heart-wrenching choice.

title: Vivah - Journey From Engagement to Marriage
desc: Poonam, an orphan engaged to wealthy Prem, suffers first-degree burns in a house fire just days before their wedding, testing love, resilience, and family bonds.

title: The Kerala Story 2: Goes Beyond
desc: Three women choose love over family expectations, but their dreams soon turn into hardship. Their journeys reveal how trust can become a path to loss and control.

title: Biwi Ho To Aisi
desc: Suraj secretly marries Shalu, a village belle, defying his domineering mother Kamla. To drive Shalu away, Kamla falsely accuses her of stealing jewellery and money.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.
